name: idd
description: Issue-Driven Development: skills that create, triage, analyze, resolve, review, and auto-pilot GitHub issues.

interface.longDescription: Turn GitHub issues into development work: create and prioritize issues, investigate solutions, implement changes, open and review pull requests, or run the backlog loop. Uses your authenticated GitHub CLI and local repository. Auto-pilot can push and merge changes.
defaultPrompt: Use IDD to triage the open issues in this repository.
